code:
producer.produce(
    topic="orders",
    key="order-4471",       # optional, decides the partition
    value='{"order_id": "4471", "total": 58.20}',
)
producer.flush()
caption: Pick a topic, optionally pick a key, send a value.

code:
producer.produce(topic="orders", key="order-4471", ...)
         |
   hash("order-4471") % num_partitions
         |
         v
   always the same partition
caption: Same key, same partition, every time — deterministic ordering for one entity.
A consumer polls for events — it is never pushed to.

subtitle: The machines actually holding these partitions.
